proposal.hypothesis: Advising the agent to prefer distro-package sources, read project build docs, and disable X/GPU features improves build-from-source task outcomes.
targetFailureModes: NonZeroAgentExitCodeError building C/C++ projects from source
builds failing on missing X11 or GPU dependencies
proposal.expectedBehaviorChange: Solve-mode prompt text additionally directs distro-package sourcing, build-doc reading and CPU-only/X11-disabled configuration; no tools, services or section inventory change.
regressionRisks: Build guidance may be over-applied to non-build tasks if the agent misreads scope.

mechanismAssertions: In solve mode the candidate registers exactly one section named candidate:identity.
The solve section text prescribes distro-package sourcing and CPU-only build configuration for build-from-source tasks.
In propose mode the candidate registers exactly one section named candidate:proposal-policy.
preservationAssertions: Disposing the candidate fiber removes the registered section and restores the pre-boot inventory exactly.
